B2B Sales Teams, Lead Generation Agencies, Sourcing Scouts, Arbitrageurs & Dropshippers.

## eBay B2B Seller Contact Lead Generator

### How it works

This workflow generates potential B2B seller leads from eBay either on demand or on a weekly schedule. It sends the run into an Apify scraping step to collect merchant contact data, then uses custom code to qualify and score the leads. Finally, it formats each qualified lead with CRM/outreach fields such as lead status and enrichment timestamp.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Apify credentials and actor/input settings in the “Scrape eBay Merchant Contacts” node for the target eBay search or seller contact source.
- Review the weekly schedule trigger to confirm Monday 8 AM matches the desired timezone and cadence.
- Check the custom scoring logic in “Qualify & Score B2B Leads” to ensure it matches your B2B qualification criteria.
- Map any CRM or outreach fields needed downstream in “Prepare CRM & Outreach Record” before connecting it to a CRM, sheet, or email tool.

### Customization

Adjust the Apify search parameters, lead scoring thresholds, and output fields to target different seller categories, regions, or outreach workflows.

## Start lead scans

Contains the manual and scheduled entry points that launch the lead generation flow either on demand or every Monday morning.

## Scrape and score leads

Collects eBay merchant contact data through Apify, then applies custom qualification and scoring logic to identify better B2B prospects.

## Prepare outreach record

Formats the scored lead data for CRM or outreach use by setting fields such as lead status and enrichment timestamp.
